boards.title: Your First Weekend at Northern Arizona University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A practical, under-21-safe first-weekend sequence using named NAU places and current official resources.

cards.title: Begin with a Flagstaff campus tour
cards.subtitle: Friday arrival • official introduction
cards.notes: Use NAU’s tour options to get oriented, ask practical questions, and identify the buildings that will matter most during your first academic week.
cards.short_summary: An official starting point for learning the Flagstaff campus layout.
cards.evidence_claim: NAU offers in-person tours of its Flagstaff campus.
cards.source_title: Explore NAU’s campuses in person or online
cards.access_notes: Review NAU’s tour page for current registration options and availability.

cards.title: Make the University Union your checkpoint
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon • Building 30
cards.notes: Walk through the Union and save its location. Its information desk, student support offices, meeting rooms, and dining choices make it a useful first-weekend reference point.
cards.short_summary: A central-campus hub with student services, shared spaces, and dining.
cards.evidence_claim: NAU describes the University Union as centrally located and lists student support departments, meeting rooms, dining, and lounge space there.
cards.access_notes: The official page lists the Union at 1050 S. Knoles Drive and provides current facility information.

cards.title: Choose a study spot at Cline Library
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon • Building 28
cards.notes: Take a quiet pass through the library, locate a study area that works for you, and bookmark its services before your first assignments arrive.
cards.short_summary: A campus library with research support, computing, and study spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: NAU says Cline Library provides research support, learning and study spaces, technology, and computing spaces.
cards.access_notes: Check the library’s official site for current building access, space reservations, and service hours.

cards.title: Spot the MakerLab for later projects
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning • Cline Library
cards.notes: Find the MakerLab while you are at Cline and note what it supports. It is a concrete place to return when a class or personal project needs hands-on making.
cards.short_summary: A Cline Library creation space with fabrication tools and consultations.
cards.evidence_claim: NAU identifies the MakerLab as a Cline Library creation space with 3D printers, a Glowforge laser cutter, and project consultations.
cards.source_title: Cline Library learning and study spaces
cards.access_notes: The library says the MakerLab is available during regular library hours; verify current access before visiting.

cards.title: Locate the Native American Cultural Center
cards.subtitle: Saturday late morning • Building 14
cards.notes: Add this center to your campus map and review its current programs before attending. Treat public programs as opportunities to listen, learn, and follow host guidance.
cards.short_summary: A named NAU center serving Indigenous students and the wider campus community.
cards.evidence_claim: NAU’s Native American Cultural Center is a campus facility that supports student organizations, recruitment, retention, and community engagement.
cards.access_notes: Confirm current programs and access guidance with the center before making a special trip.

cards.entity_name: John Haeger Health and Learning Center Recreation Center
cards.title: Get familiar with the Recreation Center
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon • Building 25
cards.notes: Find the Recreation Center in the Health and Learning Center, then check the current membership and facility rules before planning a workout or activity.
cards.short_summary: NAU’s recreation hub with fitness, courts, climbing, and study areas.
cards.evidence_claim: NAU states that its Recreation Center is located in the John Haeger Health and Learning Center and includes fitness and recreational amenities.
cards.access_notes: NAU lists the Recreation Center at 824 S. San Francisco St.; access requirements depend on current enrollment or membership status.

cards.title: Walk by Observatory Field Complex
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon • University Drive and San Francisco Street
cards.notes: Use this outdoor landmark to connect campus routes in daylight. If you want to play, check whether the fields are available rather than assuming open access.
cards.short_summary: A central-campus field complex for open play and pickup games.
cards.evidence_claim: NAU identifies Observatory Field Complex at University Drive and San Francisco Street and describes it as a central-campus mix of turf and natural grass fields.
cards.access_notes: Field availability and reservations can change; check with Campus Recreation before participating.

cards.title: Check what is on at Ardrey
cards.subtitle: Saturday evening • Performing and Fine Arts
cards.notes: Look up the current calendar and ticket details for an event that suits your weekend. Even a brief walk to the venue makes its location familiar for future performances.
cards.short_summary: NAU’s largest performing-arts center in northern Arizona.
cards.evidence_claim: NAU says Ardrey Memorial Auditorium is located at the center of campus and hosts a wide variety of events each year.
cards.access_notes: Events and admissions vary; use the official Central Ticket Office information linked by NAU before attending.

cards.title: Find South Field Complex in daylight
cards.subtitle: Sunday morning • Pine Knoll Drive and South Huffer Lane
cards.notes: Make a daytime loop to this named complex and use it as a navigation reference. Reserve or confirm access before organizing any group activity on the fields.
cards.short_summary: An NAU outdoor recreation complex with turf fields and disc golf.
cards.evidence_claim: NAU says South Field Complex at Pine Knoll Drive and South Huffer Lane includes two lit artificial-turf fields, sand volleyball courts, and an 18-hole disc golf course.
cards.access_notes: Campus Recreation manages reservations; check current access and field conditions before using facilities.

cards.title: Check the Lumberjack schedule
cards.subtitle: Sunday • choose a future home event
cards.notes: Browse the official athletics schedule together and save one future home event. Confirm venue rules and ticket details when you select a date rather than relying on old information.
cards.short_summary: An official route to NAU Division I team information and schedules.
cards.evidence_claim: NAU identifies its Lumberjacks as competing in 15 NCAA Division I sports in the Big Sky Conference.
cards.access_notes: Schedules, venues, ticketing, and entry policies vary by event; verify them on official NAU Athletics channels.
